standard_prerequisites.use: Replaces the colimit of the rings by the colimit of their henselizations.

standard_prerequisites.name: The henselization of a G-ring is a G-ring
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps the G-ring property along the colimit.

core_obligations: Write the ring as a filtered colimit of finite type algebras over the integers and localise at the primes below the maximal ideal (proof lines 12682-12685).
Record that these localisations are Noetherian local G-rings (proof lines 12684-12685).
Pass to the colimit of henselizations and use preservation of the G-ring property (proof lines 12686-12689).
Identify the colimit with the henselization of the ring, which is the ring itself (proof lines 12690-12691).
difficulty_reason: The lemma exhibits a henselian local ring as a filtered colimit of henselian local G-rings with local transition maps. The proof writes the ring as a filtered colimit of finite type algebras over the integers, localises each of them at the prime below the maximal ideal to obtain Noetherian local G-rings, and then uses two results: that the henselization of a colimit is the colimit of the henselizations, and that the henselization of a G-ring is again a G-ring. The colimit of the henselizations is then the henselization of the ring, which is the ring itself because it is henselian.
